reason: Raw plan and first diagnostic precheck show no nonempty group/file text differences or unsupported numeric values. Remaining compiler-default uncertainty is resolved empirically on the first real produced object, not by another unbounded documentation search.
AC6_only_policy: For this explicitly AC5 diagnostic variant, ignore v6Lang and other v6-prefixed project fields plus vShortEn/vShortWch. Record them as not applied rather than asserting project history or feeding AC6 options to AC5.
C_recipe_literal_inputs: Add only target literal include/Define/Undefine/MiscControls and accepted supported existing C5 flags. Avoid duplicating the exact same diag_error option. Group/file empty text inherits; first precheck confirmed no nonempty differences.
default_choices: Use this installed AC5 compiler's default endianness, enum container and wchar type without invented switches. No forced enum_is_int, wchar32, GNU mode or microlib. These are deliberately selected defaults of this diagnostic recipe, not an assertion that defaults match the legacy binary.
RTE_choices: Only literal input paths/macros and true compiler builtins; no IDE-implied _RTE_ macro, generated new-target include or new RTE headers. Existing old empty RTE header may be found only through explicit include paths.
first_actual_object_gate: After the first genuine TU produces an object, inspect saved ELF/build attributes with the already trusted fromelf --text -v. Record actual CPU/LE/SP/VFPargs/enum/wchar/denormal or UNKNOWN if not emitted. Compare with actual target intent and already saved library evidence. Unexpected/incompatible/unresolved ABI stops before next TU/link; do not silently recompile the first object with changed options.
first_compile_error: A real compiler or missing dependency error is useful evidence: preserve failed argv/stdout/stderr, actual consumed prefix and remaining unstarted. Stop exactly as approved, no automatic fixes or diagnostic reduction.
budget_unchanged: Each actual162C+1ASM at most once; still0 TU consumed at decision. Exact known armasm version query once before ASM if reached. No extra object probes are added.
